The system shall support DC and pulsed I-V as well as low-frequency impedance measurements up to 10 MHz and shall be integrated with the existing Keithley 4200A-SCS characterization system. The scope includes the prober, temperature-controlled chuck, electrical probes, optical and camera systems, control hardware and software, cabling and interfaces, installation, commissioning, operator training and integration support.
